feature: Backend AWS SDK IAM role credential selection
scope: Verify that AWS resource authentication is selected by runtime environment, without changing application-user authentication.

scenarios.setup: NODE_ENV=production; AWS_ENDPOINT_URL, AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID, and AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY unset
scenarios.expected: No emulator endpoint or explicit credentials are configured; AWS SDK default provider chain is used.

scenarios.setup: NODE_ENV=development; AWS_ENDPOINT_URL unset; emulator credentials supplied through environment or credentials file
scenarios.expected: Local emulator endpoint and local credentials are configured.

scenarios.setup: NODE_ENV=production; AWS_ENDPOINT_URL points to a non-local AWS endpoint; access-key environment variables are present
scenarios.expected: Emulator credentials are not explicitly injected into SDK client configuration.

scenarios.setup: Start the local emulator, initialize DynamoDB/S3/SQS resources, then run Playwright E2E.
scenarios.expected: Existing registration/login, protected API, file, and queue workflows continue to pass.

coverage.note: Values from the CI run for PR #128; rerun CI after this change to refresh results.
